name: Siem Reap
short_description: Gateway to the temples of Angkor, with a lively old-town, circus arts and excellent Khmer dining.
long_description: Siem Reap is the base for exploring the Angkor Archaeological Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The town itself blends night markets, boutique hotels and community arts projects, with the Tonle Sap lake and countryside villages a short ride away.
image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angkor_Wat
best_period: November to March is the most comfortable; the green season (June to October) is quieter and lush.
transport_info: Tuk-tuks and hired drivers are standard for Angkor day trips. The temples are spread over many kilometres, so plan transport for each day.
practical_info: An Angkor pass is required for entry to the park and is sold at the official ticket centre. Temple dress code applies: cover shoulders and knees.
